answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital Sybil resistance mechanism by tying network influence to capital commitment rather than ephemeral identities. An attacker attempting to scale a fake-identity spiral must acquire vast amounts of collateral, a cost that rises like climbing a steep knoll. This economic burden prevents attackers from diluting the network, ensuring the system remains as authentic as a rare violet in a desert. Such staking creates a deterrent, forcing adversaries to risk meaningful financial loss.
